scenario: Floa Window Mirror interaction gap audit

referenceEvidence.distributionNote: Glaso's public materials distinguish App Store read-only mirroring from an Interact capability described for direct distribution. The direct app binary was not available for REA inspection.

currentFloaImplementation.capture: desktopCapturer source selected and captured with getUserMedia
currentFloaImplementation.openOriginalAction: implemented through selected window id, process owner metadata, and Accessibility raise action
currentFloaImplementation.inputForwarding: implemented as explicit macOS Interact mode for pointer, drag, right-click, scroll, and mapped keyboard events
currentFloaImplementation.targetRestriction: input IPC accepts only the selected source id after mirror authorization; interaction authorization is cleared when that source is revoked
currentFloaImplementation.failureHandling: native input errors release tracked mouse buttons and keys, then revoke per-source Interact authorization; source switches and opt-out also release held inputs
currentFloaImplementation.eventOrdering: mirror input, authorization, source switching, interaction toggles, and revocation use a serialized main-process queue so a transition cannot race ahead of a pending key/button event
currentFloaImplementation.uiLabel: Preview only by default; Interact is opt-in
currentFloaImplementation.nativeImplementation: menubarx-app/FloaMirrorInput.swift, compiled as a packaged arm64 helper

technicalFeasibilityResearch.windowMetadata: Apple CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo provides window IDs, bounds, and ownership metadata.
technicalFeasibilityResearch.targetedEvents: Apple CGEvent supports posting Quartz events to a target PID.
technicalFeasibilityResearch.raiseWindow: AppKit accessibility exposes a raise action for a specific accessible window.
technicalFeasibilityResearch.privacyBoundary: Accessibility trust and Screen Recording authorization must be surfaced and tested; no permission was requested in this audit.

validation.sourceInspection: confirmed the native helper resolves the selected CGWindowID to current owner PID and bounds, while main-process IPC checks source authorization and per-source interaction enablement
validation.macPackageBuild: passed; arm64 helper included at Contents/Helpers/FloaMirrorInput and main.cjs resolves that nested-helper path
validation.failureRecovery: source syntax passed; packaged app.asar main.cjs SHA-256 matches the source and contains the fail-closed release-and-revoke branch plus serialized input/transition queue
validation.packagedHelperProtocol: accessibility status request returned valid JSON without prompting or activating Floa
validation.signing: Electron builder skipped signing because the configured Developer ID identity is not trusted; helper now resides in Contents/Helpers, the macOS nested-helper location that the signing walk can identify, but a signed build and TCC approval remain unverified

nextImplementationSteps: Run the complete interaction flow against a disposable target window without activating Floa or disturbing the user's foreground app.
Verify per-window coordinate mapping on a second display and after the target is resized.
Check TCC Accessibility approval for the packaged helper under a trusted signed app build.
Confirm mouse-up cleanup if the user switches mirror tabs while a pointer button is held.
